Emma — thanks, and congrats on moving to PO stage. Looping in Laura (billing lead) and Marissa (tax ops) to help with the matrix and to confirm AU treatment.

High-level plan (we’ll put this into the matrix and send the XLSX):
- EU (B2B): We treat B2B exports as reverse-charge when customer provides a valid EU VAT ID (VAT 0% on Redwood invoice; customer accounts for VAT under reverse-charge). We need the verified VAT ID and a copy of the EU VAT certificate for records.
- AU (services billed from AU entity): If the supply is subject to Australian GST (place of supply rules), GST at 10% may be charged on Redwood’s AU-sourced invoice. If the customer is considered an overseas recipient and reverse-charge is applicable per local rules, we can route as 0% but we need formal ABN verification and a written tax position.

Next steps I’ll action:
1) Draft taxability matrix (attached: taxability-matrix-draft.xlsx) with examples (line-item breakdown) for: EU-B2B with VAT ID, EU-B2C, AU services with/without GST withholding.
2) Laura to propose invoice routing (single invoice vs split invoice) and sample split PDF.
3) Marissa to list exactly what evidence we require to validate VAT/ABN (see vat-proof-reqs.pdf).

If you can attach the EU VAT certificate and AU ABN confirmation, we’ll validate and mark the invoice as reverse-charge-ready for EU.

Proposed timing: matrix + sample split by Thu EOD APAC (i.e., Thu 19 Aug AEDT). If you prefer a quick call tomorrow morning APAC, happy to do 30 mins.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0142

Hi Emma / team —

Quick clarifications from Billing on how we’d propose to present invoices and the sample calc:

- Single invoice with split sections: We can issue one combined invoice that has a section for EU license revenue (net of VAT when reverse-charged) and a separate section for AU professional services (GSTable). Each section will carry its own tax treatment and a short tax note ("EU services — reverse-charge; customer VAT ID validated: <id>" / "AU services — 10% GST included on AU-sourced lines"). Example attached: invoice-split-sample.pdf.

- Line-level example (from your PO):
  * Redwood Platform license — EU customers (annual) — USD 100,000 — VAT 0% (reverse-charge) — note: EU VAT ID validated
  * Implementation services — AU entity — USD 20,000 — GST 10% = USD 2,000 (if taxable in AU)
  * Invoice total (EUR/USD converted per contract) with clear tax subtotal rows.

- ABN / GST withholding: Redwood will not automatically withhold GST unless we are advised via a tax ruling or statutory requirement. If Solbytech expects a withholding treatment, we need written confirmation from your tax advisor plus the ABN verification. Marissa, please confirm the exact ABN verification flow.

Action items for us:
- We’ll validate the EU VAT ID on the VIES system once Emma sends the certificate.
- Marissa will confirm ABN verification and whether we need to apply GST/withholding on the AU lines.
- Final invoice will include line-level tax notes and the PO number.

Laura Bennett
Senior Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
